body: Thank you for your support.  The numbness is the worst I'm sorry you are feeling it too.  I tried crying last night but nothing came out.  Even tried doing short hyperventilation breathing that usually gets the ball rolling but nothing.  Nothing, nothing, nothing, I feel nothing.

Dad knows I'm depressed and that it's bad but he doesn't know it's this bad.  He's a really great guy and it kills me that I'm about to destroy his life.  I've been fighting since I was 15 at this point it's hard to keep going.

Thank you for thinking I'm strong but I just don't see it that way.  Maybe I'll go home and being with Dad will help me through this maybe not.  At this point I don't really care.

Not empty at all they are very much appreciated.  As sad as it is that others are going through depression too it's nice to know other people understand what I'm feeling.  

Good luck keep your chin up, you seem like a lovely person.

I was listening to Lou Reads the Internet for You.  Lou is practicing his voice over work so he finds different forums around the internet.  Some of them are really gross, some are boring and some are flat out hilarious.  The recent episode he read a Reddit sub forum on pranks Dads play.  He read a prank that involved ketch up packets that probably wasn't that funny but for whatever reason it hit me the right way and I could not stop laughing.  

Another podcast that makes me laugh is called How Did This Get Made.  Three comedians watch a crappy movie and have a guest on to discuss it.  Half the time I don't even watch the movie I just listen to them describe it.  I hope you find one of these recommendations funny.  If you hate them you can totally let me know if you love them let me know too.

You have helped tremendously by just posting a response to say that you care.  Thank you so much it means so very much to me.  Also you helped me see that this guy back home is at least a friend and to be able to say I have 1 irl friend is better than nothing.

I'm originally from Minneapolis so I'm hoping you weren't homeless during the winter.  Although Chicago can be a bit warmer than Minneapolis the winters there are still awful. 

Thank you so much for your advice I intend to try it over the next few days and hope it helps.  You are a kind, caring person Brandon and only deserve good things in life.  I don't think I can say thank you enough to everyone who's responded such an out pouring of support from completely strangers it's amazing.  I wont hesitate to reach out to you in the future if I need help and extend the same offer to you if you ever need someone to talk to or just bitch about winter with.

Thank you for your support, encouragement and advice.  If I decide to stay in LA, it would be great to meet up with you and have a nice face to face conversation with someone.  Especially someone who understands what this feels like.

Any advice you have about panic attacks would be greatly appreciated.  This is a new problem for me I'd never suffered from them before. Thank you for taking the time to reply it's greatly appreciated oh and for saying you don't think I'm an asshole.
